summary: removeProperty on a shorthand removes all mapped longhand declarations and returns the pre-removal shorthand serialization.

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

tests.name: normal
tests.expected_behavior: returns prior shorthand and removes mapped longhands

tests.name: edge
tests.expected_behavior: return can be empty when a serializable complete shorthand did not exist, while present mapped longhands are still removed
